title: Generated LAYERFILTER malformed-body recovery profile
scope: CLI disposition for one bounded malformed LAYERFILTER OBJECTS body across six generated DWG revisions, including following-frame continuation, strict refusal, and explicit-partial output readback where admitted.

selection.source: P6-F typed OBJECTS parser recovery inventory
selection.reason: DRW_LayerFilter has a bounded typed DWG parser with a counted vector of variable-text names, allowing a small generated failure profile without introducing layer-reference or rendering claims.

source.provenance: Generated from scratch by the local dwg_local_roundtrip test writer in the temporary test directory; generated DWG and DXF files are removed by the test runner.
source.profile: One custom AcDbLayerFilter object at handle 0x700 with one RECOVERY_LAYER name, followed by a LINE at handle 0x701.
source.mutation: The generator captures the valid custom-class frame, searches only its bounded body for a one-bit mutation rejected by DRW_LayerFilter::parseDwg, and preserves the common prologue and object handle. The selected count mutation requires a second name for which no bounded TU remains.

AC1027.output: refused by the existing source-reference gate

assertions: Each source reports one failed OBJECTS frame, continues to the following LINE, and balances source, published, and failed frame accounting.
Strict ASCII/Binary conversion refuses atomically and preserves the destination sentinel at AC1015, AC1018, AC1021, AC1024, and AC1032.
Explicit-partial ASCII/Binary conversion and fresh DXF readback retain the LINE at AC1015, AC1018, AC1021, AC1024, and AC1032.
AC1027 strict and explicit-partial output remain refused by the existing source-reference gate.
